description: This file defines the JsonNoteRepository class which implements the INoteRepository interface. It manages notes stored in a JSON file, providing thread-safe CRUD operations with support for configuration-based file paths. It also includes an extension method for dependency injection registration.

classes.name: JsonNoteRepository
classes.description: A thread-safe, JSON-file based repository implementation for notes, supporting async CRUD operations and configuration-based file path management.

methods.name: EnsureLoadedAsync
methods.description: Loads notes from the JSON file into the cache if not already loaded.

methods.name: PersistAsync
methods.description: Persists current cache state to the JSON file.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Returns all notes, ordered by most recent update.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its GUID if it exists.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new note, assigning a new GUID if necessary, and saves it.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing note if present.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a note by GUID if it exists.
